home.heroFotoAlt: The Campo Lago fig tree at dusk, home of Dharma Fest
home.quienesSomosCuerpo: We produce the finest wellness experiences in Costa Rica. We connect people with what makes them feel good, and brands with the audience they are looking for.
home.temasCierre: A network of more than 100 wellness professionals
home.cifrasPersonas: People who have lived a Dharma experience
home.cifrasBase: A database of more than 26K people
home.roadCuerpo: Recurring premium experiences all year round, 80 to 200 participants each. An intimate format with high retention and a real connection to the Dharma community. The festival is the annual gathering. Road to Dharma is the community all year long.
home.sedeCuerpo: Campo Lago, just outside San José, with three halls and open grounds.
home.impactoCuerpo: Our purpose is to leave a mark and grow community at every event.

formularios.sumateCuerpo: Leave us your email and we will let you know about Dharma Fest 2027 and every Road to Dharma.
formularios.mensaje: Tell us what you are looking for
formularios.consentimiento: I allow Dharma Fest to store my email address in order to send me information about the festival and the Road to Dharma experiences. I can unsubscribe at any time.

privacidad.pendiente: This page is waiting on the legal text that Dharma Fest must provide: the data processing policy and the identity of the data controller, as required by Costa Rican Law 8968.
privacidad.mientrasTanto: In the meantime: emails left on this site are used only to announce the festival and the Road to Dharma experiences. They are never shared with third parties. To unsubscribe, write to info@dharmafestcr.com.

patrocinios.heroCuerpo: People are saturated with content. A digital ad competes for seconds of distracted attention. At Dharma your brand becomes an experience.
patrocinios.publicoCuerpo: An active, aspirational community that invests in its physical, mental and spiritual wellbeing. They look for authentic experiences connected to whole health. They are influential, they value sustainability, and they choose premium brands and experiences.
patrocinios.estilo: Whole wellbeing · Music & art · Nature and sustainability · Social media & premium experiences
patrocinios.mediosDesdeLista: Communication starts months before the event · Partner brands are part of the whole campaign, not just the festival · And they stay with the community at every Road to Dharma all year long
patrocinios.loQueViene: Two full days for the first time · 2,000 projected attendees · 30+ brands at the Mercadito · An expanded programme across movement, health, food and music
patrocinios.paquetesCuerpo: Three ways to be there. Write to us and we will send you the proposal with the investment for each one.
patrocinios.mercaditoCuerpo: A conscious space for local brands that promote whole wellbeing. More than 30 brands in the 2027 edition.

borrador.roadCuerpo: Between one edition of Dharma Fest and the next, the community does not go quiet. Road to Dharma experiences host 80 to 200 people: small enough that everyone gets called by name, frequent enough that wellbeing stops being a once-a-year event and becomes a habit.
borrador.roadDato: 80 to 200 participants · Intimate format · All year round
borrador.festivalIntro: The third edition. Two full days for the first time.
borrador.festivalCuerpo: Two days at Campo Lago with an expanded programme across movement, health, food and music, more than 30 brands at the Mercadito and 2,000 projected attendees.
borrador.nosotrosCuerpo: We produce the finest wellness experiences in Costa Rica. We connect people with what makes them feel good, and brands with the audience they are looking for.
